# Load Libraries and Data
```{r}
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(limma)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(gbm)
library(pROC)
library(ggplot2)
library(caret)
library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
library(pdp)


# Load the SKCM data
data <- load("SKCM.rda")
```

# Data Preparation
```{r}
clinical <- colData(query2) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(patient, gender, vital_status, days_to_death, 
         ajcc_pathologic_stage, age_at_diagnosis) %>%
  mutate(
    survival_time = days_to_death / 365,
    event = ifelse(vital_status == "Dead", 1, 0),
    age_diagnosis = age_at_diagnosis / 365
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(survival_time) & !is.na(event))

log_expr <- log2(assay(query2, "fpkm_uq_unstrand") + 1)

matched_samples <- intersect(rownames(clinical), colnames(log_expr))
clinical <- clinical[matched_samples, ]
log_expr <- log_expr[, matched_samples]
```

# Feature Selection
```{r}
select_top_var_genes <- function(expr, n = 1000) {
  top_genes <- names(sort(apply(expr, 1, var), decreasing = TRUE))[1:n]
  return(top_genes)
}

select_surv_genes <- function(expr, time, event, n = 50) {
  pvals <- sapply(1:nrow(expr), function(i) {
    fit <- tryCatch(coxph(Surv(time, event) ~ expr[i,]), error=function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(fit)) summary(fit)$coefficients[1, 5] else 1
  })
  names(pvals) <- rownames(expr)
  top_genes <- names(sort(pvals))[1:n]
  return(top_genes)
}

top_genes <- select_top_var_genes(log_expr, 1000)
log_expr_sub <- log_expr[top_genes, ]
surv_genes <- select_surv_genes(log_expr_sub, clinical$survival_time, clinical$event, 50)
expr_final <- t(log_expr[surv_genes, ])

surv_data <- as.data.frame(expr_final) %>%
  mutate(
    survival_time = clinical$survival_time,
    event = clinical$event,
    gender = factor(clinical$gender),
    age_diagnosis = clinical$age_diagnosis,
    stage = factor(case_when(
      grepl("I", clinical$ajcc_pathologic_stage) ~ "Early",
      grepl("II", clinical$ajcc_pathologic_stage) ~ "Intermediate",
      grepl("III|IV", clinical$ajcc_pathologic_stage) ~ "Advanced",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ))
  )

```

# Remove Zero-Variance Predictors (keep outcome columns)
```{r}
nzv <- nearZeroVar(surv_data %>% select(-survival_time, -event), names = TRUE)
surv_data <- surv_data[, setdiff(colnames(surv_data), nzv)]
```

# Train/Test Split
```{r}
set.seed(42)
idx_event <- which(surv_data$event == 1)
idx_censored <- which(surv_data$event == 0)

train_idx <- c(
  sample(idx_event, size = round(0.7 * length(idx_event))),
  sample(idx_censored, size = round(0.7 * length(idx_censored)))
)
test_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(surv_data)), train_idx)

train_data <- surv_data[train_idx, ]
test_data <- surv_data[test_idx, ]

```

# Metrics Functions
```{r}
calculate_cindex <- function(pred, time, status) {
  survival::concordance(Surv(time, status) ~ pred)$concordance
}


```

# GBM Survival Model
```{r}
build_gbm_survival_model <- function(train_data, test_data,
    n.trees = 500, interaction.depth = 3, shrinkage = 0.01, n.minobsinnode = 5) {

  predictors <- setdiff(colnames(train_data), c("survival_time", "event"))
  form <- as.formula(paste("Surv(survival_time, event) ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))

  gbm_model <- gbm(
    form, data = train_data, distribution = "coxph",
    n.trees = n.trees, interaction.depth = interaction.depth,
    shrinkage = shrinkage, n.minobsinnode = n.minobsinnode,
    bag.fraction = 1, verbose = FALSE
  )

  pred <- predict(gbm_model, newdata = test_data, n.trees = n.trees, type = "link")
  test_data$risk_score <- pred

  # 1-year survival classification
  test_data$surv_1yr <- with(test_data, ifelse(survival_time <= 1 & event == 1, 1, 0))
  valid <- with(test_data, survival_time >= 1 | (survival_time < 1 & event == 1))

  auc_val <- NA
  if (sum(valid) > 10) {
    roc_obj <- pROC::roc(test_data$surv_1yr[valid], test_data$risk_score[valid])
    auc_val <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj))
  }

  list(
    model = gbm_model,
    test_data = test_data,
    cindex = calculate_cindex(pred, test_data$survival_time, test_data$event),
    auc = auc_val
  )
}


gbm_res <- build_gbm_survival_model(train_data, test_data)
```

# Visualizations
```{r}
# Risk score density
density_plot <- ggplot(gbm_res$test_data, aes(x = risk_score, fill = factor(event))) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "forestgreen", "1" = "firebrick")) +
  theme_minimal() + labs(title = "Risk Score Distribution", x = "Risk Score")

# ROC curve for 1-year mortality
gbm_res$test_data$surv_1yr <- with(gbm_res$test_data, ifelse(survival_time <= 1 & event == 1, 1, 0))
valid <- with(gbm_res$test_data, survival_time >= 1 | (survival_time < 1 & event == 1))
roc_plot <- if (sum(valid) > 10) {
  roc_obj <- pROC::roc(gbm_res$test_data$surv_1yr[valid], gbm_res$test_data$risk_score[valid])
  auc_val <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj))
  ggroc(roc_obj) + geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") + theme_minimal() + labs(title = "ROC for 1-Year Mortality", subtitle = paste("AUC =", round(auc_val, 3)))
} else {
  ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "Not enough samples for ROC") + theme_void()
}

# Variable importance
varimp_plot <- ggplot(gbm_res$var_importance[1:20,], aes(x = reorder(var, rel.inf), y = rel.inf)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") + coord_flip() + theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Top 20 Variables", x = "Gene", y = "Relative Importance")

# PDPs
top_vars <- head(gbm_res$var_importance$var, 3)
pdp_plots <- lapply(top_vars, function(v) {
  pd <- partial(gbm_res$model, pred.var = v, n.trees = gbm_res$model$n.trees, train = train_data)
  autoplot(pd) + ggtitle(paste("Partial Dependence:", v)) + theme_minimal()
})

```

# Metrics Table
```{r}
metrics <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("C-index", "AUC (1-Year Mortality)"),
  Value = c(round(gbm_res$cindex, 3), ifelse(is.na(gbm_res$auc), "Not enough samples", round(gbm_res$auc, 3)))
)
knitr::kable(metrics, caption = "GBM Model Evaluation Metrics")
```
